_about: Methane (1) + Water (2): equilibrium states (T, P, x, y), 283.14-298.15 K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record, compositions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2.

source.citation: A. Bottger, A. P. S. Kamps, G. Maurer, An experimental investigation of the phase equilibrium of the binary system (methane + water) at low temperatures: Solubility of methane in water and three-phase (vapour + liquid + hydrate) equilibrium, Fluid Phase Equilib. 407 (2016) 209-216
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1. The table number in the article was not checked.
source.transcription: Read from the ThermoML XML by validation/python/hp_gas_solubility.py; values as stored. The person checking compares each row with the record.

notes: Read with validation/python/hp_gas_solubility.py. The record gives the molality m of methane (mol per kg of water); x_1 = m / (m + 1000/M_2), M_2 = 18.01528 g/mol. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
